title: Dale, New Mexico as a tall white playground

tellings.quote: let's say out by Dale here in New Mexico, which is one of the tall white playgrounds,

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years around the "tall whites," tall pale beings he says he met while serving at Area 51, the secret Air Force site in Nevada, tells Michels that the area around Dale, New Mexico is "one of the tall white playgrounds." He says it as part of his own first-hand account, which, if true, would mean these beings roam freely in parts of the American Southwest.
